newsitem.title: CHINA: CHONGQING CHANG'AN UP 9.87 PCT AT NOON.
newsitem.headline: CHONGQING CHANG'AN UP 9.87 PCT AT NOON.

text.p: Chongqing Chang'an's hard currency B shares rose HK$0.31 or 9.87 percent to HK$3.45 at midday on Monday after the automobile maker posted strong results for first half 1997, brokers said.
Trading volume of Chongqing Chang'an hit 360,200 shares valued at HK$1.24 million in Monday's morning session.
"Investors were buying the counter because the company's interim results were better than expected," an analyst at China Guotai Securities said.
The company on Saturday posted net profits of 125.91 million yuan for the first half of 1997, up 41 percent from 89.15 million yuan in the year-ago period.
